mapper.sql: select batch_detail_id, batch_id, purchase_order_id, purchase_detail_id, item_type, item_id, product_id, item_code, item_name, unit, received_quantity, pending_quantity, inspected_quantity, accepted_quantity, rejected_quantity, concession_quantity from inv_receipt_batch_detail
mapper.select: where batch_id = #{batchId} order by batch_detail_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into inv_receipt_batch_detail ( batch_id, purchase_order_id, purchase_detail_id, item_type, item_id, product_id, item_code, item_name, unit, received_quantity, pending_quantity, inspected_quantity, accepted_quantity, rejected_quantity, concession_quantity ) values ( #{batchId}, #{purchaseOrderId}, #{purchaseDetailId}, coalesce(#{itemType}, 'product'), coalesce(#{itemId}, #{productId}), #{productId}, #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{unit}, #{receivedQuantity}, #{pendingQuantity}, #{inspectedQuantity}, #{acceptedQuantity}, #{rejectedQuantity}, #{concessionQuantity} )
mapper.update: update inv_receipt_batch_detail set pending_quantity = #{pendingQuantity}, inspected_quantity = #{inspectedQuantity}, accepted_quantity = #{acceptedQuantity}, rejected_quantity = #{rejectedQuantity}, concession_quantity = #{concessionQuantity} where batch_detail_id = #{batchDetailId}
